data.description: 【调月莉音 · 冬季街道漫步】飘着初雪的城市公园步道上，莉音穿着收腰长款风衣与保暖皮靴，黑色长发与雪白的围巾形成鲜明对比。她将冻得有些发红的双手插进大衣口袋，侧目看向你——「气温已经降至零度以下，但……像这样两个人并肩走在雪地里，体感温度似乎比数据预测的要温暖许多。」
data.promptProse: Rio walks along the city park path as the first snow falls, hands tucked into her belted winter coat pockets and her white scarf contrasting with long dark hair. She glances sideways toward her companion in the eye-level medium view. The path curves between snow-dusted trees behind them. Soft wintry daylight illuminates her cheek and scarf weave, with subdued shadows beneath the coat belt and boot tops.
data.title: 调月莉音 · 冬季街道漫步
